Micro2Nano.why: makes MEMS probe cards for memory wafer test (mainly SK Hynix NAND) and has been qualified by a major customer for HBM EDS probe cards; probe cards are 95.68% of revenue
Micro2Nano.evidence: DART half-year report 08-14-2026: 'the company obtained qualification from a major global customer for probe cards used in the HBM EDS (Electrical Die Sorting) process'; main customers are SK Hynix, MINGZHEN MEMs Tech and Daeyang Electric

players.product: MEMS probe cards for NAND and DRAM wafer test, incl. HBM EDS probe cards (qualified by a major customer); HBM4 high-current probe card in development

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, separate statements): H1 revenue KRW 19,824,974,340 vs KRW 10,822,071,750 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 1,907,828,233 vs an operating loss of KRW 594,026,260. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 11,178,622,900 (Q2 2025: KRW 5,350,807,000), operating profit KRW 1,132,613,113 (Q2 2025: loss of KRW 1,136,010,376). H1 revenue mix: NAND probe cards 93.40%, DRAM probe cards 2.28%, foundry (microneedles, pressure sensors, V-grooves) 4.31%; probe cards KRW 18,968,074 thousand (95.68%). Exports KRW 5,398,140 thousand, domestic KRW 14,426,834 thousand.

Capacity and utilisation, H1 2026: probe-card capacity of 325 units (based on bonding-equipment output at an average 35,000 pins per card) against production of 236, a utilisation of 72.62% (FY2025: 34.91%; FY2024: 43.63%); 29 cards in ending inventory. H1 property, plant and equipment additions were KRW 1,787,696 thousand; construction in progress stood at KRW 1,332,791 thousand. Inventories rose to KRW 9,616,829,093 from KRW 8,048,190,555 at the start of the year.
quarterly_data.figure: Utilisation 72.62% (236 of 325 probe cards); FY2025 34.91%; PP&E additions KRW 1,787,696 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: HBM: the company obtained qualification from a major global customer for probe cards used in the HBM EDS (Electrical Die Sorting) process, which it says secures the competitiveness it needs for the HBM and AI-chip test market. The DRAM EDS probe-card market is currently led by one or two overseas firms (FormFactor and MEK, the Korean subsidiary of Micronics Japan); the company expects gradual penetration. R&D plan: a high-current probe card for HBM4, a high-speed probe card for LPDDR6, DRAM EDS probe-card approval and roll-out, and SSD-controller test probe cards; a government project on an ultra-low-Ron PMIC for HBM MEMS probe cards runs 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31 (KRW 800,000 thousand grant). H1 R&D spend KRW 3,245,978 thousand (14.81% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: HBM EDS probe card qualified; H1 R&D KRW 3,245,978 thousand (14.81% of revenue)

quarterly_data.signal: Customers: main customers in 2026 are SK Hynix, MINGZHEN MEMs Tech and Daeyang Electric; the top three account for about 97.36% of revenue. Customer A accounted for KRW 13,550,564 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: KRW 7,989,312 thousand), customer B KRW 5,155,761 thousand and customer C KRW 594,520 thousand. MINGZHEN MEMs Tech (Ningbo), a 16.28%-owned associate, is the company's sales agent for probe cards across China; H1 sales to it were KRW 5,155,760 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 1,437,565 thousand). The company says Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are both encouraging domestic probe-card suppliers to expand for supply security, and that domestic makers hold 100% of the NAND probe-card market while overseas firms hold most of the DRAM market.
quarterly_data.figure: Top 3 customers ~97.36% of revenue; customer A KRW 13,550,564 thousand; MINGZHEN sales KRW 5,155,760 thousand

connects_to.relationship: MEMS probe card supply for SK Hynix NAND / DRAM wafer test

contracts.signal: SK Hynix is Micro2Nano's main customer under a master materials trading agreement for probe cards and related products signed 2009-03-01 (renews automatically each year). SK Hynix requests the probe cards it needs each quarter 2-3 months ahead and selects suppliers; average lead time is about 6 weeks. SK Hynix NAND probe cards are supplied by three firms (Micro2Nano, TSE and AMST), with shares set each quarter by SK Hynix's monthly quality scoring, and the company says it holds a high share.
